user.title: Create a limited dashboard
user.description: Choose the dashboard name and the short name used in its web address.

entity_filter.description: Choose a type to narrow the list. You can add more types without losing your selections. Plugs are switches marked as outlets in Home Assistant; other plugs are under Switches.
